title: Pretty and Easy to clean
text: Pretty and Easy to clean. I love the design on these pots. Its easy to cook food and clean. My biggest con is that they chip easily mainly on the top rim of the pot and on the sides of the pot its self. I had this set for about 3 months.

description: Anyone can be a sous chef with the help of NutriChef 11 Piece Nonstick Diamond Pattern Kitchen Cookware Set. This 11-piece non-stick kitchenware set features a stylish modern cookware design and elegant diamond pattern to match any kitchen. The set includes a 1.7-quart saucepan pot with a lid, a 3.6-quart Dutch oven pot with a lid, a 2.1-quart cooking pot with a lid, an 11-inch large fry pan, an 8-inch small fry pan, soup ladle, pasta fork, and spatula. With cool-touch and form-fitting handle grips, you can handle the pots and pans comfortably. The cookware set effectively distributes and retains heat so your food will be evenly cooked all around. The see-through tempered glass lids are great for keeping an eye on your food and the vent holes allow steam to escape. Cook up a storm on your gas, electric, ceramic, or induction counter cooktop with the NutriChef 11 Piece Nonstick Diamond Pattern Kitchen Cookware Set.
